name: vintage-music-streaming
description: Aplicación de streaming musical vintage con roles Admin, Artista y Usuario

scripts.dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend-admin: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:admin && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:admin
